description: Land Title  Settlement Department -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2031/24 of 09.08.2017, Homagama D/S Division  - Cad. Map No. 520008
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific land parcels, their locations, ownership details, and amendments to land title records. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership details, and amendments to land title records without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
